map.高度角和方位角有什么区别？: What's the Difference Between Altitude and Azimuth?
map.高度角是太阳相对地平线的仰角，方位角是它在地平圈上的方向（东—南—西），两者共同: The altitude is the angle of the sun above the horizon, and the azimuth is its direction on the horizon circle (east–south–west); together they fix the sun's position.
map.为什么冬天太阳高度低？: Why Is the Sun Low in Winter?
map.冬季太阳赤纬为负（在南半球），使正午高度角比夏季低约 2×23.44°≈47°，: In winter the solar declination is negative (in the southern hemisphere), so the noon altitude is about 2×23.44°≈47° lower than in summer, with more oblique and shorter sunshine.
